lines.text: Solomon stands at the altar, hands spread toward heaven, and says God has fulfilled His promise to David.
Solomon says the highest heavens cannot contain God, and he asks God to hear prayers from heaven, His dwelling place.
When sinful Israel is defeated, returns, and prays, Solomon asks God to hear from Zion and forgive.
Solomon asks God to do all the foreigner asks, so that all peoples of the earth will know His name.
Solomon says God brought His people out of Egypt and spoke of setting them apart through His servant Samuel.
